column3: MT 57:1–2; the following verses of this psalm are MT +1. NASB sets the title in braces, but this copy closes the brace early and puts the last clause in parentheses. Close to the Hebrew.
“God who avenges for me” is rendered “God who accomplishes all things for me,” with “all things” supplied.
Close to the Hebrew; “who crushes me” is rendered “who tramples upon me,” and “faithfulness” as “truth.”
“Those who devour” (or “who are aflame”) is rendered “those who breathe forth fire”; NASB supplies “I must” and “Even.”
Close to the Hebrew; “for my feet” is rendered “for my steps.”
Close to the Hebrew; “my honor” is rendered “my glory.”
Close to the Hebrew; “faithfulness” is rendered “truth.”
